description: Substations and Transformers (HP-013) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Horizon Power. This dataset describes the approximate location of structures used to support the Horizon Power’s transmission and distribution Network in the regional areas of Western Australia. WARNING: This data should be considered approximate only and is intended to give the user a reasonably good idea of location relative to their own area of interest. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Horizon Power. It offers 5 resource(s) in .zip shapefile, file geodatabase, mapinfo mid/mif, api arcgis server map service, pdf, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom_other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
